answer_2.quote: We introduce two evaluation metrics most frequently used in this paper. (1) ∆P rob, the decreasing value of answer probability after features/neurons ablation, which assesses the impact of knowledge storage units on knowledge expression. (2) IS, Interpretability Score, which measures the interpretability of features.

answer_3.quote: We modify the method from  to adapt it to our task (detailed in Appendix C.2). Briefly, for features or neurons, we ask Large LMs (this paper uses gpt-4o-mini) to predict their activations. The correlation between the model's predicted activations and the actual activations is the interpretability score.
